import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;
import java.util.TreeSet;

public class Div2_421C_Variant1 {

	public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
		BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
		StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
		int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
		int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
		long l = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
		long r = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

		if (r - l + 1 >= 2 * (a + b)) {
			System.out.println(a <= b ? a + 1 : 2 * a - b);
			return;
		}

		StringBuilder pattern = new StringBuilder();
		for (int i = 0; i < a; i++) {
			pattern.append((char) ('a' + i));
		}

		l--;
		r--;

		TreeSet<Integer> usedChars = new TreeSet<>();
		int minDistinct = 26;

		for (int firstChar = 0; firstChar < 26; firstChar++) {
			for (int secondChar = a; secondChar < 26; secondChar++) {
				StringBuilder currentString = new StringBuilder(pattern);
				for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
					currentString.append((char) ('a' + firstChar));
				}
				usedChars.clear();
				for (char c : currentString.substring(currentString.length() - a).toString().toCharArray()) {
					usedChars.add(c - 'a');
				}
				int nextCharIndex = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < a; i++) {
					while (usedChars.contains(nextCharIndex)) {
						nextCharIndex++;
					}
					currentString.append((char) ('a' + nextCharIndex));
					nextCharIndex++;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
					currentString.append((char) ('a' + secondChar));
				}
				int length = currentString.length();
				usedChars.clear();
				for (int i = (int) (l % length); i != (r + 1) % length; i = (i + 1) % length) {
					usedChars.add(currentString.charAt(i) - 'a');
				}
				if (usedChars.size() < minDistinct) {
					minDistinct = usedChars.size();
				}
			}
		}
		System.out.println(minDistinct);
	}
}
